needs.thing: the young Hist on the platform with a grey paste in its closed scar

signs.detail: a young Hist some 6 m tall standing in the wardens' pool, against the east side of the cypress tent platform
Heem-Jasa, the tree's minder, works on the platform beside it and sleeps there

needs.why: Partly met. The young Hist (King of the Murkmire's HistTree04) stands in the pool against the tent platform, and Heem-Jasa is cast on the camp's apothecary, who sleeps on the platform. The sealed scar is the quest's own thing on the trunk. But the platform is not yet joined to the bank: its deck is a walkable island, so neither the player nor Heem-Jasa walks from the bank to the tree.
needs.fit: The tree is where the record has it, at the platform's side in its pool.
needs.narrow: Yes: a gangway of the source's cypress planks from the platform's east edge to the east bank's street (the join laid one piece and the deck stayed an island).

signs.detail: a scale-hide lean-to on the west bank, beside a tall dead swamp tree, with a crate, two clay urns and a knapsack on its open west side
the game names the knapsack "Sap-Takers' Pack"

needs.why: Met for the place. The hide stands on the west bank some 1,300 units west of the woven weir (five Saxhleel fences across the creek below the pool), beside a lone dead swamp tree, with a crate for the note and urns beside the quest's own jar of sap, and the sap-takers' pack. The three Unbound, the note and the jar are the quest's to place.
